decisions.reason: As a large telecom firm we would likely retain this still-new conferencing service for another year because it fits enterprise communications and no clear failure relative to aspiration is yet visible, even if website emphasis is limited.
The reported customer adoption indicates performance above a reasonable aspiration level for a new network service, so there is little reason to withdraw it.
A dedicated page suggests strategic importance and commitment, and with only one year on the market a large firm has enough slack to continue learning before judging it a failure.
This portal likely supports the existing voice business at relatively low incremental cost, so absent evidence of serious underperformance we would keep it.

Carrier pre-selection is a legacy telephony offer in a declining segment, and with only weak website presence it is the product most likely to fall below aspiration and have its resources reallocated.

Direct voice network connection still complements core telecom services, and a large firm would usually tolerate another year of uncertain results before exiting unless performance clearly disappoints.
